documentation_note: LibUCW documents ucw-xml in ucw-xml/doc/xml.txt and the documented declarations of ucw-xml/xml.h (xml_init, xml_push_fastbuf, xml_next pull states, xml_ns_enable and xml_ns_by_id), published as the LibUCW XML parser manual.
scope: ucw-xml's namespace-resolved pull events of one in-memory document: document-order expanded element and attribute names, attribute order and decoded values, namespace-declaration count and distinct bound URIs, maximum depth, and trimmed character-data runs between markup
namespace_note: ucw-xml resolves namespaces itself once xml_ns_enable() is called (xml.h, 'Namespaces'): every element and attribute carries a namespace ID (xml_ns_by_id gives the URI; 0 = no namespace) and its local name; unprefixed attributes get no namespace. Namespace declarations stay in the element's attribute list: xmlns:p in the xmlns namespace (XML_NS_XMLNS) and the default xmlns with no namespace. The harness counts those as declarations (their non-empty values are the bound URIs) and does not report them as attributes.
family_note: ucw-xml (parse.c, ns.c, source.c, dtd.c, common.c) is LibUCW's own XML parser over its fastbuf streams; it links no other XML library and is independent of expat, libxml2, GMarkup, IXML, Mini-XML, nXML and RXP. The pyexpat oracle is a different family.
verification_note: Namespace-aware path: both valid controls give the exact shared summary, including declaration counts 2 and 3.
